description: 3D experiment 5: weak scaling of the 3D pigment from one core to 256. One thread per rank and a fixed 256 x 256 x 64 block per rank (4.2 million cells) on square process grids (1x1, 2x2, 4x4, 8x8, 16x16, pencils). The spacing dx = dy = dz = 1/256 is fixed: the basin grows in x and y (lx = px*local_nx*dx, ly = py*local_ny*dy) and keeps the depth lz = 0.25 with 64 layers, so dt and the number of steps are the same for every run. The other settings, the frozen flow included, come from benchmark_problem_3d.json; the blob centre is set per resource, at mid-depth.
